headline: Release readiness front door
body_copy: This opens the saved Release readiness door pack. It is exact as an entry, not proof of current provider state; routing it only creates weaker setup.
why_this_button: Inspect remains the honest first move. Route is available only as a weak setup move into a saved-view candidate, not as approval.
danger_if_hidden: The operator may treat a saved entry as live release status.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: Summon/inspect is weak; stronger moves require live or fresh review basis.

headline: Current provider head
body_copy: Object Browser is showing the current issues provider head for the release readiness view.
why_this_button: Compare lets the operator see how live truth differs from saved, cut, or derived lanes before taking consequence.
danger_if_hidden: A live beacon could be mistaken for approval to promote unrelated imported or stale material.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: The provider head is fresh, but promotion still needs the candidate and receipt path.

headline: Fast summary needs recheck
body_copy: The local readiness summary was built from an older cut after the saved view moved to release-view@13.
why_this_button: Recheck is primary because the summary is useful but stale against the current definition.
danger_if_hidden: The operator may promote from a fast derived panel that no longer matches source truth.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: Recheck against release-view@13 and live provider head before promote or publish.

headline: Teammate packet arrived
body_copy: The teammate packet is useful as a snapshot, but it is not adopted into local release consequence.
why_this_button: Peek is primary because imports should be useful before trust while staying restricted.
danger_if_hidden: Foreign packet contents could be laundered into local release truth.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: Adopt or quarantine locally before any stronger consequence.

headline: Preview only
body_copy: Object Browser showed the imported packet without adopting or mutating local state.
why_this_button: Inspect keeps the weak preview legible before local adoption.
danger_if_hidden: A preview could be confused with local acceptance.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: Preview does not create an adoption receipt.

headline: Arrival is adoptable, not promoted
body_copy: Triage marked the arrival adoptable. It remains weaker than a promotion receipt.
why_this_button: Adopt is now honest because triage created a local adoptable receipt, but promotion still needs fresh basis.
danger_if_hidden: Adoptable could be mistaken for already promoted.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: Promotion still needs fresh recheck and promotion receipt.

headline: Promote blocked by basis drift
body_copy: This review item passed against release-view@12, but the current saved definition is release-view@13.
why_this_button: Recheck is the smallest honest route back to a promotable basis.
danger_if_hidden: A stale review queue item could promote just because it once passed.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: Recheck against release-view@13 and current provider head before promotion.

headline: Fresh basis established
body_copy: The review item has been rechecked against release-view@13 and the live provider head.
why_this_button: Promote is allowed because the basis is fresh and the recheck receipt is available.
danger_if_hidden: The operator cannot tell why a formerly blocked item became promotable.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: Fresh recheck receipt supports promotion; publication/settlement remain separate.

headline: Promotion recorded
body_copy: Helm recorded a local promotion after fresh recheck. This receipt proves local consequence, not current provider truth.
why_this_button: Inspect is primary because the strong act has already happened and the receipt should be examined, not repeated.
danger_if_hidden: The receipt could be mistaken for live provider status or receiver visibility.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: Receipt scope is local historical consequence only.

headline: Recall shows what happened
body_copy: Recall returns the promotion receipt as history. Recheck if you need current live status.
why_this_button: Recheck is primary because Recall cannot turn history into present truth.
danger_if_hidden: Old state could be treated as current release readiness.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: Historical receipt needs a new live check before present-tense claims.

headline: Shared view candidate
body_copy: This candidate captures the Release readiness definition for reuse. It is weaker than current live truth, weaker than a review cut, and weaker than a promotion receipt.
why_this_button: Route is honest because the object is setup material; it can become a patrol route without claiming current readiness.
danger_if_hidden: A reusable saved view could be mistaken for a reviewed or live release status.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: Saving/routing a view is weak. Review queue and promotion require later cut and recheck gates.

headline: Nightly patrol route armed
body_copy: The route is current as a subscription definition, but it is weaker than current live truth, weaker than a review cut, and weaker than a receipt.
why_this_button: Triage is honest because a patrol route may queue findings but cannot directly promote them.
danger_if_hidden: A subscription can look like active review or approval unless its setup-only posture is visible.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: The route can create a queue entry, but any consequential action requires the queue cut and recheck.

headline: Review queue item awaits fresh recheck
body_copy: This queue entry is exact at review-cut C8, but it is weaker than current live truth and weaker than a receipt. Recheck before promoting.
why_this_button: Recheck is the honest bridge from a proposed cut to a current live basis.
danger_if_hidden: The operator may treat a queued cut as already safe to promote.

receipt_or_recheck_gate.explanation: Promotion is forbidden until this queue cut is rechecked against the live source and current definition.
